CH-clara.prompt:
The attached images are close-up STYLE references of heroines from top-grossing mobile merge-2 games (Tasty Travels, Hotel Legacy). Reproduce their exact character rendering and face design language, but create a NEW original character: do NOT copy their faces, hats, outfits, hair, jewelry, props or poses.

RENDER (match the references precisely): stylized semi-3D painted look, as if a 3D character were rendered then painted over: smooth airbrushed volumetric shading, soft subsurface glow on skin with rosy cheeks and nose tip, glossy specular highlights on hair, lips and eyes, NO ink outlines at all (edges defined only by color and light), very bright, clean, high-saturation, high-contrast colors, warm sunny key light plus soft rim light. FACE design like the references: large almond-shaped glossy eyes with big irises, thick dark upper lashes and winged liner, strong bright catchlights, arched defined brows, small upturned nose, wide joyful open-mouth smile showing teeth, glossy lips, light freckles, slightly heart-shaped face. Expression and pose full of energy and charm, like a hero on an App Store screenshot.

CHARACTER: Clara, 28, owner of the Bloom Corner concept store (flowers + little cafe + fashion). Chestnut-brown wavy shoulder-length hair with glossy highlights and a cream satin ribbon bow, bright emerald green eyes. Fresh sage-mint green blouse with rolled sleeves, cream florist apron with a coral embroidered flower, small gold flower earrings. Half-body, three-quarter view, one hand on hip, the other arm cradling a lush bouquet of pink peonies and coral roses held close to her face.

BACKGROUND: solid plain pale warm cream color, nothing else, for easy cutout. No text, no watermark, no UI.

FLW-chain.prompt:
The attached images are ART STYLE references only (top-grossing mobile merge-2 games). Match the rendering of their BOARD ITEMS exactly, but do NOT copy their items, layout, logos or text.

RENDER STYLE for items: premium merge-2 item icons, soft semi-3D painted look: chunky rounded volumetric shapes, smooth airbrushed gradients, strong glossy specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean crisp edges WITHOUT heavy dark outlines, high saturation, warm top-left light. Each icon must read clearly at 100 px: one bold silhouette, few large shapes, simplified details, slightly exaggerated cute proportions. No brush texture, no sketch lines.

CONTENT: an item sheet of 6 separate icons arranged in a clean 3 x 2 grid with generous even spacing on a plain pale warm cream background, each icon centered in its cell, same scale and same camera angle (slight top-down 3/4 view), a soft contact shadow under each. This is the FLOWER merge chain of the game Bloom Corner, level 1 to 6, each level visibly bigger, richer and more valuable than the previous: 1) a small paper seed packet with a flower picture and a few seeds; 2) a small glossy terracotta pot with a fresh green sprout; 3) a single long-stem glossy red rose with a dew drop; 4) a small hand-tied bouquet of pink roses and daisies wrapped in kraft paper with twine; 5) a big bouquet of peonies and roses in pink pearlescent wrapping with a large satin bow; 6) a wicker basket overflowing with roses and peonies, golden glow and sparkles around it. No text, no numbers, no labels, no frames.
